description.summary: captures rendered to fit a size of the client's choosing

protocol.description:
This protocol lets a client ask for captures of an image capture source rendered to fit within a size of its choosing, rather than at the source's own size.
A preview of a whole desktop holds a small fraction of the desktop's pixels. Drawing it at that size in the compositor spares a full-size render and the copy of every pixel of it to the client, which would only scale it down again; a preview kept live then costs a preview's worth per frame.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: kora_image_capture_size_manager_v1
interface.description: Sets the size captures of a source are rendered to fit within.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the server that the client will no longer use this global. Sizes already set stay in effect.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: fit captures of a source within a size

request.description:
Captures of sessions created from this source afterwards are rendered to fit within width by height buffer pixels, keeping the source's aspect ratio; the session's buffer_size is the fitted size. A width or height of zero restores the source's own size. Sessions created before this request are not affected.
Which kinds of source honour the size is up to the compositor; captures of any other kind keep the source's own size.

arg.name: source
arg.summary: the source to size captures of
